checks.description: VPC flow logs must be enabled to capture IP traffic metadata for audit and incident response. An aws_flow_log resource with vpc_id set is required. Note: tfsec custom checks cannot validate that every aws_vpc resource has a corresponding aws_flow_log — this check verifies that VPC-scoped flow log resources exist and are correctly formed.
checks.impact: Without VPC flow logs, network-level traffic to and from EC2 instances is invisible. Attackers can perform lateral movement, data exfiltration, or reconnaissance with no audit trail
checks.resolution: Create an aws_flow_log resource referencing the VPC via vpc_id. Set traffic_type to ALL (not ACCEPT or REJECT only) and configure log_destination to CloudWatch Logs or S3
checks.errorMessage: VPC flow log resource is missing vpc_id — flow logs must be associated with a VPC
